home.text: You have a right to your actions, but never to the fruits of your actions.
Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
Today is victory over yourself of yesterday.
Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
If you don't take risks, you can't create a future.

software.text: First, solve the problem. Then, write the code.
Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
Make it work, make it right, make it fast.
Premature optimization is the root of all evil.
Power isn't determined by your size, but the size of your heart and dreams.

ml.text: All models are wrong, but some are useful.
The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
A lesson without pain is meaningless.
Hard work is worthless for those that don't believe in themselves.
Believe in the me that believes in you!

cloud.text: Do every act of your life as though it were the very last act of your life.

llmops.text: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
If you win, you live. If you lose, you die. If you don't fight, you can't win!
All models are wrong, but some are useful.
I'll leave tomorrow's problems to tomorrow's me.

fit:Boxing.text: Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee.
Don't quit. Suffer now and live the rest of your life as a champion.
Everybody has a plan until they get punched in the mouth.
It ain't about how hard you hit. It's about how hard you can get hit and keep moving forward.
Discipline is doing what you hate to do, but doing it like you love it.

fit:Running.text: Pain is inevitable. Suffering is optional.
Run when you can, walk if you have to, crawl if you must; just never give up.
When you give up, that's when the game ends.

fit:Gym.text: 100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats and a 10 km run. Every single day.
Today is victory over yourself of yesterday.
Discipline is doing what you hate to do, but doing it like you love it.

hob:Games.text: It's dangerous to go alone! Take this.
With great power comes great responsibility.
A man chooses, a slave obeys.
Ah shit, here we go again.

hob:Reading.text: A reader lives a thousand lives before he dies. The man who never reads lives only one.
The more that you read, the more things you will know. The more that you learn, the more places you'll go.
If I have seen further, it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.

social.by: Steve Jobs, Stanford 2005 (from the Whole Earth Catalog)
